about.heading: Engineering Excellence Since Inception
about.intro: HAVA by Haryrock Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of pneumatic rock drilling equipment, born from decades of engineering expertise and an unwavering commitment to industrial quality.
about.description: Our journey is defined by precision manufacturing, technical innovation, and a deep understanding of the mining, tunnelling, and construction industries. We don't just sell equipment — we engineer solutions that perform reliably in the world's most demanding environments.

rockDrills.name: Rock Drills
rockDrills.description: High-performance pneumatic rock drills for drilling operations in mining, quarrying, and construction. Built for durability, precision, and efficient air consumption.

drifter.name: Drifter
drifter.description: Heavy-duty drifters for tunnelling and underground drilling applications. Designed for continuous operation with optimal penetration rates and rock breakage.

pavementBreakers.name: Pavement Breakers
pavementBreakers.description: Powerful pneumatic breakers for demolition, pavement breaking, and concrete removal. Engineered for maximum impact energy with ergonomic handling.

pusherLeg.name: Pusher Leg
pusherLeg.description: Pneumatic pusher legs for rock drill support and feed control. Provides stable drilling positioning with adjustable feed pressure for various applications.

airlineAccessories.name: Airline Accessories
airlineAccessories.description: Complete range of airline equipment including lubricators, filters, regulators, and hoses. Essential for maintaining optimal pneumatic tool performance.

extensionEquipment.name: Extension Equipment
extensionEquipment.description: Drill steels, rods, and extension equipment for various drilling depths. Manufactured with high-grade steel for long service life and reliable performance.

buttonBits.name: Button Bits
buttonBits.description: Premium quality button bits for all rock drilling applications. Available in various sizes and button configurations for different rock formations.

spareParts.name: Spare Parts
spareParts.description: Comprehensive inventory of genuine spare parts for rock drills, drifters, and breakers. Ensures minimal downtime with ready availability and quality assurance.

whyHava.heading: Why Buyers Choose HAVA
whyHava.intro: When performance, durability, and dependable support matter, buyers choose manufacturers they can trust.

manufacturer.title: Manufacturer, Not Trader
manufacturer.description: Direct control over product design, quality assurance, and after-sales support through our own engineering and manufacturing facility. No middlemen, no compromises — just direct manufacturer relationships.

engineering.title: Engineering-Led Experience
engineering.description: Decades of technical expertise in pneumatic drilling equipment, backed by continuous product development and field-tested improvements. Our engineers understand drilling because they live it.

durability.title: Built for Demanding Conditions
durability.description: Products engineered to withstand rugged site environments, extreme temperatures, and continuous operation with minimal maintenance requirements. Tested in the world's toughest worksites.

ecosystem.title: Complete Product Ecosystem
ecosystem.description: From primary drilling equipment to accessories and spare parts — a comprehensive solution from a single, reliable manufacturer. One supplier, total coverage.

value.title: Competitive Commercial Value
value.description: Direct manufacturer pricing without intermediary markups, combined with product quality and reliability that delivers long-term value. Lower total cost of ownership.

export.title: Export-Ready Capability
export.description: International quality standards, export documentation support, and proven experience serving customers across 15+ countries. Ready for global deployment.

industries.heading: Engineered for Core Industrial Applications
industries.intro: HAVA products are used across industries where drilling performance, durability, and dependable equipment support are essential.

mining.name: Mining
mining.description: Surface and underground mining operations requiring reliable drilling equipment for exploration, development, and production blasting.

tunnelling.name: Tunnelling
tunnelling.description: Tunnel construction and underground excavation projects demanding precision drilling and continuous equipment performance.

construction.name: Construction
construction.description: Building foundations, road construction, and infrastructure projects requiring efficient rock drilling and demolition equipment.

quarrying.name: Quarrying
quarrying.description: Stone quarrying and aggregate production operations needing durable drilling equipment for consistent rock breakage.

marbleGranite.name: Marble & Granite
marbleGranite.description: Dimensional stone extraction requiring controlled drilling for block separation and minimized material damage.

rockDrillDry.name: RH-658/5L Dry Rock Drill
rockDrillDry.description: High-performance dry rock drill with 5L air consumption, ideal for mining and quarrying applications with superior penetration rates.

rockDrillWet.name: RH-656/4W Wet Rock Drill
rockDrillWet.description: Wet drilling rock drill with integrated water flushing system for dust suppression and improved drilling efficiency in underground operations.

drifter.name: BBC-120F Drifter
drifter.description: Heavy-duty hydraulic drifter for tunnelling applications, delivering exceptional power and reliability in continuous drilling operations.

breaker.name: HR-117 Pavement Breaker
breaker.description: Powerful pneumatic breaker with high impact energy for efficient pavement breaking, demolition, and concrete removal work.

pusherLeg.name: BMK62S Pusher Leg
pusherLeg.description: Pneumatic pusher leg with adjustable feed control and stable positioning for optimal rock drill support and operator comfort.

lubricator.name: BLG-30 Airline Lubricator
lubricator.description: Automatic airline lubricator ensuring proper tool lubrication for extended equipment life and optimal pneumatic tool performance.

manufacturing.heading: Manufacturing That Builds Confidence
